title: DNS accounts
description: Logins at DNS providers for Let's Encrypt over DNS-01: certificates without port 80, before DNS points here, and later for wildcard names.
removeText: The credentials are deleted from the panel. Sites that get their certificate over this account must switch to HTTP or to another account first. The login at the provider stays; revoke the token there too.
added: {{label}} added and checked: it can write its zones.

cname.title: Recommended: a separate zone for the challenges
cname.text: Create _acme-challenge.example.com CNAME example.com.acme.example.net once per domain and give the account only the zone acme.example.net. Then its token needs no rights on your real zones.

new.title: Add DNS account
new.description: The panel creates and deletes a test record in each zone to check the access. The credentials are stored encrypted and never shown again.
new.label: Name
new.labelHint: Shown in the list, for example "INWX main account".
new.zonesHint: One zone per line, for example example.com. A domain uses the account whose zone covers its _acme-challenge name, after a CNAME.

hints.cloudflare: Create an API token with Zone: Read and DNS: Edit for the needed zones only. Never use the global API key.
hints.hetzner: Use a read/write token of a separate Hetzner Cloud project that holds only DNS zones. A token of a project with servers can delete those servers.
hints.inwx: Use a sub-user with DNS rights only, if your INWX account offers one.

errors.dns_account_exists: A DNS account with this name exists. Choose another name.
errors.dns_zone_taken: Another DNS account serves this zone. Each zone belongs to one account.
errors.dns_account_in_use: Sites or the panel address still get their certificate over this account. Switch them to HTTP or give the zone to another account first.
errors.dns_accounts_unavailable: DNS accounts are not available on this panel.
errors.not_found: This DNS account does not exist any more. Reload the page.

challenge.http: HTTP: a file on port 80, the domains must point to this server
challenge.dns: DNS: a TXT record through a DNS account
challenge.adminOnly: Only admins can choose DNS, because it uses their DNS accounts.
challenge.noAccounts: DNS needs a DNS account for every domain. Add one under DNS accounts.

done.http: Let's Encrypt checks the domains over HTTP from now on.
done.dns: Let's Encrypt checks the domains over DNS from now on.
